integrity: An analytical proof is included; finite exact-rational calculations corroborate the claim but are not its proof. Provenance of cited earlier publications is identified; no priority or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite acyclic source–sink unit-flow polytopes with every edge on an s–t route, at least two routes, and a positive diagonal edge metric. Does not imply general netflow or cyclic-network analogues. Historical originality remains provisional, and independent mathematical audit is outstanding.
title: Electrical antichain widths determine inballs of acyclic unit-flow polytopes
